1186.description: This world is lightly obscured by a gloom cloud.

1187.name: Gloom
1187.description: A gloom cloud enveloped this world.
1187.description_cn: 一朵阴霾云笼罩着这个世界。

1188.name: Dense Gloom
1188.description: A thick gloom cloud obscures this world from view.
1188.description_cn: 一片厚厚的阴霾云遮住了这个世界。

1190.name: Unreachable
1190.description: Our sensors can no longer monitor this planet.
1190.description_cn: 我们的传感器无法再监测这个星球。

1193.name: Gloom Border
1193.description: This world is on the border of the interstellar wall of gloom.
1193.description_cn: 这个世界位于阴霾星际墙的边界上。

1194.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: ORBITAL NAPALM BARRAGE

1194.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1195.name: DSS Construction Site- Phase 1
1195.description: Construction has began on the Democracy Space Station.  The local populace is honored to host thousands of construction crews for this historic event.

1196.name: DSS Logistics Hub
1196.description: Parts for the Democracy Space Station are prefabricated all over the Galaxy, then shipped here to await assembly.
1196.description_cn: 民主空间站（DSS）的部件在星系各地完成预制，然后运往这里等待组装。

1197.name: Xenoentomology Center
1197.description: Those who study Terminid behavior, ecology and E-710 potential gather here for cross-disciplinary research.
1197.description_cn: 研究终结族行为、生态学以及710元素潜能的学者在此汇集进行跨学科研究。

1198.name: Deep Mantle Forge Complex
1198.description: The smelters and refineries on this planet turn crude materials into usable hardware.
1198.description_cn: 此星球上的冶炼厂和精炼厂可将原料变为实用的硬件。

1199.name: DSS Construction Site- Phase 2
1199.description: Democracy Space Station construction is well underway. The local economy is flourishing as the planet's populace has centupled, and all the Galaxy can feel their democratic fervor.
1199.description_cn: 民主空间站（DSS）的建设进展顺利。随着该星球的人口增长，经济也飞速蓬勃发展起来，全星系都能感受到他们的民主热情。

1200.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: A/ARC-3 TESLA TOWER
1200.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1200.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1202.name: THE JET BRIGADE (Enemies)
1202.description: The Automatons have deployed a new series of specialized models on this planet. These upgraded bots utilize stolen Jump Pack technology, heartlessly pillaged from the bodies of fallen Helldivers and reverse-engineered into something nearly unrecognizeable.
1202.description_cn: 在此处的机器人选择抛弃防御力，转而使用低空协同突进战术。做好准备，把他们炸上天。

1203.name: THE JET BRIGADE

1204.name: LIBERTY DAY
1204.description: This planet is celebrating Liberty Day.

1205.name: DSS CONSTRUCTION SITE - PHASE 3
1205.description: Construction of the Democracy Space Station is nearing completion. This project, which has employed millions, will soon take its place among the greatest achievements of Democracy.
1205.description_cn: 民主空间站（DSS）将近完工。这个数百万人参与建设的项目将是民主伟业最伟大的成就之一。

1206.name: TERMINID RESEARCH PRESERVE
1206.description: Terminids are held safely within massive compounts on this planet for study and E-710 extraction.

1207.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: E/MG-101 HMG EMPLACEMENT
1207.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1207.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1209.name: EAGLE STORM
1209.description: The DSS deploys Eagle Strafing Runs during missions.
1209.description_cn: 民主空间站在任务中部署“飞鹰”机枪扫射。

1210.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
1210.description: Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.
1210.description_cn: #V_ONE强化资源在全部任务中自动激活。

1211.name: PLANETARY BOMBARDMENT
1211.description: The DSS fires nonstop orbital bombardments from its suite of 77 PRESIDENTIAL-Class Cannons, providing planetwide artillery support and accelerating liberation efforts. Temporarily, also increases Reinforcement Budget by +1 per squad member and augments all loadouts with FX-12 Shield Generator Relay Stratagem.
1211.description_cn: 民主空间站利用其77门总统级加农炮不间断地进行轨道轰炸，为整个星球提供炮火支援，加速解放进程。同时提高增援预算，每位队员增援+1，此外利用“FX-12防护罩生成中继器”战略配备强化所有武装配置。

1212.name: EAGLE STORM (Marker)
1212.description: Map marker for the Eagle Storm effect.
1212.description_cn: 任务期间将周期性部署“飞鹰”机枪扫射

1213.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE (Marker)
1213.description: Map marker for the Orbital Blockade effect.
1213.description_cn: DSS启用零重力反舰导弹系统，将会瞄准该星球上所有试图离开的敌方目标。同时将多余战力投入到超级驱逐舰后勤支援。在此期间，在该星球执行任务的小队将自动激活 “强化资源：绝地喷射仓空间优化” ；且该星球上的敌军无法对其他星球发动入侵战役。

1214.name: BOMBARDMENT LIBERATION BOOST
1214.description: Progress in Liberation Campaigns is accelerated by 150%.
1214.description_cn: 在解放战役中的进展加速。

1215.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
1215.description: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet.
1215.description_cn: 此星球无法发起保卫战役。

1216.name: EAGLE STORM
1216.description: Enemy progress in Defense Campaigns is slowed.
1216.description_cn: 敌人在保卫战役中的进展放缓。

1217.name: DEMOCRACY SPACE STATION
1217.description: A Helldiver-operated weapon of mass liberation. Paid for with the blood of soldiers and the credits of taxpayers, this technological marvel is Democracy made manifest.
1217.description_cn: 绝地潜兵操纵的大规模解放武器。用士兵鲜血和纳税人税款铸就的这一技术奇迹堪称民主的象征。

1222.name: Regen Override
1222.description: Regen Rate is set to a fixed 10000 per hour.

1226.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1228.name: MERIDIAN BLACK HOLE (old map marker)
1228.description: The prosperous Meridia was corrupted into a Terminid Supercolony, necessitating its destruction using the mysterious Dark Fluid.  This galactic scar is all that remains.
1228.description_cn: 曾经欣欣向荣的默里迪亚沦为终结族超级拓殖地，不得不使用神秘的暗液体将其摧毁。如今唯有这道银河系的疤痕，昭示着它曾经的存在。

1229.description_cn: 曾经欣欣向荣的默里迪亚沦为终结族超级拓殖地，不得不使用神秘的暗液体将其摧毁。如今唯有这道银河系的疤痕，昭示着它曾经的存在。

1230.name: MERIDIAN BLACK HOLE
1230.description: The prosperous Meridia was corrupted into a Terminid Supercolony, necessitating its destruction using the mysterious Dark Fluid. This galactic scar is all that remains. Advisory: volatile spacetime fluctuations currently prohibit FTL travel to the Meridian Black Hole.
1230.description_cn: 曾经欣欣向荣的默里迪亚沦为终结族超级拓殖地，不得不使用神秘的暗液体将其摧毁。如今唯有这道银河系的疤痕，昭示着它曾经的存在。警告：时空波动不稳定，目前无法通过超光速跃迁前往默里迪恩黑洞。

1232.description: The hard workers on this planet produce goods vital to the war effort, as well as to the prosperity of Super Earth.
1232.description_cn: 此星球上的辛勤工人生产重要物资，用于支援战争以及超级地球的光明未来。

1233.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: STA-X3 W.A.S.P. LAUNCHER
1233.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the StA-X3 W.A.S.P. Launcher Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1233.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1234.description: On this planet, the Ministry of Science's best and brightest work on their next breakthrough.
1234.description_cn: 在此星球上，科学部的顶尖人才正在全力推动下一项突破。

1235.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: MD-17 ANTI-TANK MINES
1235.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1235.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1236.name: CENTER FOR CIVILIAN SURVEILLANCE AND SAFETY
1236.description: The Ministry of Truth analyzes citizens' activity, speech, data, DNA, RNA, and neural topology here.
1236.description_cn: 真理部在这里分析公民的活动、言论、数据、DNA、RNA和神经拓扑结构。

1237.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: ORBITAL 380MM HE BARRAGE
1237.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1237.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1238.name: OPERATIONAL SUPPORT
1238.description: The presence of the DSS near this planet provides a slight boost to Liberation Campaign progress.
1238.description_cn: DSS停靠在这颗星球附近一定程度上也有助于推进解放战役。

1239.name: JET BRIGADE FACTORIES
1239.description: Vertically enhanced Jet Brigade soldiers are produced here.
1239.description_cn: 经过垂直强化的喷气旅士兵就在这里出产。

1240.name: VERGE OF DESTRUCTION
1240.description: This planet is under threat of destruction.

1241.name: FRACTURED PLANET
1241.description: All that remains of a planet torn apart by the Meridian singularity. A solemn reminder of the desolation Tyranny leaves in its wake.
1241.description_cn: 被默里迪恩奇点摧毁的星球残骸。它庄严地提醒着我们，暴政必将带来毁灭。

1242.name: MOVING PLANET
1242.description: This planet is moving and is estimated to impact Super Earth.

1243.name: PREDATOR STRAIN (Enemies)
1243.description: A Gloom-enhanced strain of Terminids has been reported on this planet. SEAF patrols have been lured into ambushes, and picked off by unseen assailants. Every ounce of a Helldiver's superior senses will be required to hunt down this dangerous threat.
1243.description_cn: 根据报道，这颗星球上的终结族体现出极强的攻击性，且学会了高速移动的能力与表层伪装色，做好准备，以迅雷之势清扫这些变种。

1244.name: Spore Burst Strain (Enemies)
1244.description: A Gloom-enhanced strain of Terminids has been reported on this planet. They can explode into spores.
1244.description_cn: 这颗星球上的虫子发生了变异，会释放特殊的信息素，使得其他同变种个体分泌大量肾上腺素。做好准备，以非暴力手段应对这些为彼此提速的敌人。

1246.description_cn: 无法在此星球发动战役。

1247.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: MD-8 GAS MINES

1248.name: THE INCINERATION CORPS (Enemies)
1248.description: An Automaton unit equipped with flame throwers and incendiary ammunition is active on this planet. These wanton arsonists will not rest until they have razed all that humankind holds dear.
1248.description_cn: 在此处的机器人配备了大量火焰装备。来吧，去给他们浇点油。

1249.name: THE INCINERATION CORPS
1249.description: An Automaton unit equipped with flame throwers and incendiary ammunition is active on this planet. These wanton arsonists will not rest until they have razed all that humankind holds dear.
1249.description_cn: 在此处的机器人配备了大量火焰装备。来吧，去给他们浇点油。

1252.name: FRACTURED PLANET
1252.description: All that remains of a planet torn apart by the Meridian singularity. A solemn reminder of the desolation Tyranny leaves in its wake.
1252.description_cn: 被默里迪恩奇点摧毁的星球残骸。它庄严地提醒着我们，暴政必将带来毁灭。

1254.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: MG-206 HEAVY MACHINE GUN
1254.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1254.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1256.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: E/GL-21 GRENADIER BATTLEMENT
1256.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the E/GL-21 Grenadier Battlement Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1256.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1261.name: EXOSUIT RESERVES
1261.description: The presence of the DSS near this planet provides a -35% cooldown reduction to the EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit stratagem.
1261.description_cn: DSS停靠在这颗星球附近，可使所有外骨骼装甲战略配备冷却时间缩短35%。

1262.name: EXOSUIT RESERVES
1262.description: The presence of the DSS near this planet provides a -35% cooldown reduction to the EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit stratagem.

1263.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: M-105 STALWART
1263.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the M-105 Stalwart Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1263.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1267.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: ORBITAL GAS STRIKE
1267.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the Orbital Gas Strike Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.

1268.name: NEGATIVE ENERGY LABORATORY
1268.description: Scientists without fear of implosion or spaghettification study negative energy here.
1268.description_cn: 无惧内爆与意大利面条化风险的科学家在这里研究负能量。

1269.name: The Great Host
1269.description: The Illuminate invasion fleet, constructed in secret behind the veil of the Meridian Wormhole. It is headed for Super Earth itself.
1269.description_cn: 在默里迪恩虫洞掩护下秘密建造的光能者入侵舰队。目前正向超级地球进发。

1274.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: M-105 STALWART
1274.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the M-105 Stalwart Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.

1276.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: FX-12 SHIELD GENERATOR RELAY
1276.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the FX-12 Shield Generator Relay Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1276.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1277.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: ORBITAL NAPALM BARRAGE
1277.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the Orbital Napalm Barrage Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1277.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1279.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: M-102 FAST RECONNAISSANCE VEHICLE
1279.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1279.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1280.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: ORBITAL SMOKE STRIKE
1280.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the Orbital Smoke Strike Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1280.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1281.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: EAGLE SMOKE STRIKE
1281.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the Eagle Smoke Strike Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.
1281.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1282.name: HELLDIVER TRAINING FACILITIES
1282.description: Here, the best of the best go through the rigorous Helldiver training that will earn them their capes.
1282.description_cn: 万里挑一的精英在这里接受严格的绝地潜兵训练，争取赢得披肩。

1283.name: FACTORY STRIDER SURGE
1283.description: Significantly higher Factory Strider numbers have been observed on this planet.

1284.name: ARSENAL AUGMENTATION: GR-8 RECOILLESS RIFLE
1284.description: High Command has authorized the temporary addition of the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle Stratagem to all Helldiver loadouts.

1285.name: IMPALER RAMPAGE
1285.description: Significantly higher Impaler numbers have been observed on this planet.

1286.name: NEW HOPE CONSTRUCTION SITE
1286.description: One of 3 Maximum Security Cities is under construction here.

1287.name: NEW HOPE CITY
1287.description: The flagship Maximum Security City. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.
1287.description_cn: 最高安全级别城市中的王牌。暴政无法攻破之城，联邦的未来。

1288.name: SPORE BURST SCAVENGER RAMPAGE
1288.description: Significantly increased levels of Spore Burst Scavengers have been reported on this planet.

1291.name: NEW ASPIRATION CITY
1291.description: One of 3 Maximum Security Cities. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.
1291.description_cn: 三大最高安全级别城市之一。暴政无法攻破之城，联邦的未来。

1292.name: NEW YEARNING CITY
1292.description: One of 3 Maximum Security Cities. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.
1292.description_cn: 三大最高安全级别城市之一。暴政无法攻破之城，联邦的未来。

1293.name: CHARGER RAMPAGE
1293.description: Significantly increased levels of Chargers have been reported on this planet.

1295.name: TYRANNY PARK 2
1295.description: The extensive Terminid enclosures here allow scientists to study Terminid behavior, and civilians to take pictures with Brood Commanders.
1295.description_cn: 大量终结族圈养在这里，方便科学家研究它们的行为，公民也可以和虫族指挥官拍照留念。

1303.name: RUPTURE STRAIN (ENEMIES)
1303.description: A deadly strain of ground-bursting Terminids is present on this planet.
1303.description_cn: 情报显示，这颗星球上的终结族体现出极强的腐蚀性，且学会了掘地等手段免疫常规攻击，做好准备，应对这些精通于地下突袭的变种。

1304.name: OUTPOST ALPHA
1304.description: The first manned site established in Gloom-infested space.
1304.description_cn: 首个在“阴霾”侵蚀星域建立的人类驻军据点。

1306.name: DRAGONROACHES (Enemies)
1306.description: Terminid Dragonroaches menace the skies of this planet.
1306.description_cn: 该星球上的吐酸泰坦选择进化出了飞行能力，不过原始本能使得它们不会成群出现，做好夺取制空权的准备。

1307.name: HIVE LORDS (Enemies)
1307.description: Terminid Hive Lords have been detected on this planet.
1307.description_cn: 该星球上的终结族演变出了复数个皮糙肉厚的庞然大物，做好面对虫群与广域动量攻击的准备。

1308.name: HIVE LORDS
1308.description: Terminid Hive Lords have been detected on this planet.
1308.description_cn: 该星球上的终结族演变出了复数个皮糙肉厚的庞然大物，做好面对虫群与广域动量攻击的准备。

1309.name: DRAGONROACHES
1309.description: Terminid Dragonroaches menace the skies of this planet.
1309.description_cn: 该星球上的吐酸泰坦选择进化出了飞行能力，不过原始本能使得它们不会成群出现，做好夺取制空权的准备。

1310.name: RUPTURE STRAIN
1310.description: A deadly strain of ground-bursting Terminids is present on this planet.
1310.description_cn: 情报显示，这颗星球上的终结族体现出极强的腐蚀性，且学会了掘地等手段免疫常规攻击，做好准备，应对这些精通于地下突袭的变种。

1311.name: HIVE WORLD
1311.description: This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny. It is a source of Gloom spores.
1311.description_cn: 这颗星球已被终结族彻底侵占，从内到外被改造成了暴政的虫巢。现已变成了“阴霾”孢子的来源。

1324.name: ULTRAMAFIC MINE
1324.description: A mine extracting platinum from deep-seated deposits of igneous rock.
1324.description_cn: 从深层火成岩中开采铂金的矿井。

1329.name: LIBERTY DAY CELEBRATION
1329.description:
Super Earth, our home, is the center of Liberty Day Festivities. Together, all citizens can watch on television the annual Defense Parade, the Justice Executions, and of course, the Freedom Fireworks. 

On this special day, Helldivers are encouraged to visit Super Earth and watch this year's fireworks from their Super Destroyers.
1329.description_cn: 超级地球，我们的家园，是解放日庆典的中心。所有公民都能在电视上观看年度阅兵、正义裁决，当然还有自由烟花秀。 在这特别的日子里，所有绝地潜兵都可以前往超级地球，并在自己的驱逐舰上观看今年的烟花秀。

1342.name: CENTER FOR THE CONFINEMENT OF DISSIDENCE (CECOD)
1342.description: This planet-wide ultra-high-security facility provides ample space for the secure confinement of terrorist dissidents until they are fully rehabilitated and re-educated.

1344.name: PANDORA BASE
1344.description: The top-secret site where augmentations to the DSS are constructed.
1344.description_cn: DSS强化设施的绝密搭建地点。

1352.name: CONVENTIONAL BLACK HOLE
1352.description: This former planet is now nothing but a normal, stable black hole.
1352.description_cn: 这颗昔日行星现在不过是一个没什么特别的稳定黑洞。

1353.name: DATA CENTER
1353.description: The Automatons store large amounts of encrypted information here.
1353.description_cn: 机器人将大量加密信息储存在这里。

1355.name: HEAVY ARMOR SURGE
1355.description: Prepare to counter high numbers of heavily armored enemies.
1355.description_cn: 做好反坦克准备，面对重甲机器人大军。

1357.name: HULK SURGE
1357.description: High numbers of enemy Hulks have been reported on this planet. Prepare to counter heavily armored enemies.
1357.description_cn: 地图扫描显示，该地部署了大量的蹂躏者。

1359.name: DEVASTATOR SURGE
1359.description: The Automatons have deployed high numbers of Devastators to this planet.
1359.description_cn: 机器人在该星球部署了大量歼灭者。

1360.description: Cyborgs are deployed to the battlefield of this planet, leading their Automaton armies.
1360.description_cn: 做好准备，面对经过精英化训练，涵盖全射程打击的生化人部队与邪恶机器组成的部队。
1360.name: CYBORGS (Enemies)

1361.description: Cyborgs are deployed to the battlefield of this planet, leading their Automaton armies.
1361.description_cn: 做好准备，面对经过精英化训练，涵盖全射程打击的生化人部队与邪恶机器组成的部队。
1361.name: CYBORGS

1373.name: CLASS 1 EXOSTORM
1373.description: Isolated Exostorm pockets are materializing across the planet and rapidly gaining momentum.
1373.description_cn: 多个异界风暴区分别在星球各地出现，迅速积聚势头。

1374.name: CLASS 2 EXOSTORM
1374.description: Exostorm fronts are coalescing into a dense system that threatens to engulf the entire planet.
1374.description_cn: 异界风暴锋面正在汇聚，形成质密的风暴系统，恐将吞噬整颗星球。

1375.name: CLASS 3 EXOSTORM
1375.description: The Exostorm has reached critical mass, enveloping the planet in an ominous tempest that defies atmospheric physics.
1375.description_cn: 异界风暴已达到临界质量，整颗星球都被这场不祥的风暴所裹挟，彻底颠覆大气物理定律。

1376.name: The Void
1376.description: This world is enveloped by The Void.
1376.description_cn: 由于过多的异界尖塔导致的重力场域异常现象，已使整颗星球堕入寂域。在任何探测器都找不到的地方...不敢想象发生了什么...

1377.name: MINDLESS MASSES (Enemies)
1377.description: The Illuminate are converting large numbers of Super Earth citizens into Voteless-type enemies on this planet. Prepare to face a twisted, indoctrinated horde.
1377.description_cn: 光能者正在这颗星球上将大批超级地球公民转化为无票者型敌人。准备迎战这群遭到洗脑、思维扭曲的暴徒。

1378.name: MINDLESS MASSES
1378.description: The Illuminate are converting large numbers of Super Earth citizens into Voteless-type enemies on this planet. Prepare to face a twisted, indoctrinated horde.
1378.description_cn: 光能者正在这颗星球上将大批超级地球公民转化为无票者型敌人。准备迎战这群遭到洗脑、思维扭曲的暴徒。

1379.name: APPROPRIATORS
1379.description: The Illuminate are deploying only their own kind to this planet, a clear indication of the operation's importance and/or xenophobic nature. Prepare to face foot soldiers, drones, and piloted mechanical constructs.
1379.description_cn: 光能者部署在这颗星球上的只有同族，这抑或说明此次行动至关重要，抑或暴露出他们排外的本性。准备迎击他们的步兵、无人机以及操作型机械体。

1380.name: APPROPRIATORS (Enemies)
1380.description: The Illuminate are deploying only their own kind to this planet, a clear indication of the operation's importance and/or xenophobic nature. Prepare to face foot soldiers, drones, and piloted mechanical constructs.
1380.description_cn: 光能者部署在这颗星球上的只有同族，这抑或说明此次行动至关重要，抑或暴露出他们排外的本性。准备迎击他们的步兵、无人机以及操作型机械体。

1386.name: SPORE BURST STRAIN
1386.description: A mutation causes Terminids on this planet to generate excess hormonal spores, which drive other similarly mutated Terminids into a frenzy. Prepare to face enemies that bolster each others' speed.
1386.description_cn: 一场突变导致该星球上的终结族产生过量激素孢子，驱使其他发生类似突变的终结族陷入狂暴。准备迎击这些为彼此提速的敌人。

55.name: INCREASED STARTING AMMO
55.description: Helldiver deploys with maximum number of magazines for their weapons.

67.name: EXPERIMENTAL SUPER SOLDIERS
67.description: The Helldiver has faster stamina regeneration and slowly regenerates health and injuries automatically.

70.name: INTEL SCANNERS
70.description: The location of Intel is indicated on the mini-map.

71.name: COMPROMISED INTEL PACKAGES
71.description: Intel Packages are compromised. Picking them up will notify the enemy of your whereabouts and cause an encounter.

76.name: IMPENETRABLE DEFENSE
76.description: The defenses of this planet are so strong that no enemy will be able to invade.

77.name: CRIPPLED SUPPLY
77.description: The ability of this planet to attack is crippled.

87.name: MORE BATTLEFIELD AMMO
87.description: Battlefield pickups on all planets contain #AMOUNT% more ammo.
87.description_cn: 所有星球上的战场拾取物中将增加#AMOUNT%的弹药。

113.name: PLENTYFUL STIMS
113.description: Health Packs and Supply boxes contains #V_ONE more Stim Packs.

114.name: LESS BATTLEFIELD AMMO
114.description: Battlefield pickups on all planets contain #AMOUNT% less ammo.
114.description_cn: 所有星球上的战场拾取物中将减少#AMOUNT%的弹药。

121.name: MARKET CRASH
121.description: Due to the risk of Famine, the market is concerned and prices have gone up #V_ONE%.

1144.name: AMMO SHORTAGE
1144.description_cn: 绝地潜兵部署时携带弹匣数减少#V_ONE%。

1159.name: ACCOUNTING CORRECTIONS
1159.description: Boosts Requisition and XP awards by 50% to address accounting errors (responsible parties undergoing re-education).
1159.description_cn: 申购点和经验奖励增加50%以修正核算错误（负责人正接受二次教育）。

1178.name: WEAPONS EXPERIMENTATION
1178.description: The #V_ONE stratagem is available to all Helldivers.
1178.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1208.name: PLANETARY BOMBARDMENT
1208.description: The DSS fires Orbital Barrages during missions.
1208.description_cn: 民主空间站在任务中发射轨道火力网。

1312.name: LIGHT GLOOM COVER
1312.description: Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds.
1312.description_cn: “阴霾”粒子干扰“鹈鹕”运输机着陆，撤离时间延长20秒。

1313.name: MODERATE GLOOM BLANKET
1313.description: The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%.
1313.description_cn: “阴霾”已完全笼罩这颗星球，阻碍我们开展各类后勤行动。 撤离时间延长30秒，“飞鹰”重新装弹时间延长20%。

1315.name: HEAVY GLOOM SHROUD
1315.description: This planet is completely engulfed by the Gloom, severely impeding logistical support. Extraction times are increased by 40 seconds, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30% and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.
1315.description_cn: 这颗星球完全被“阴霾”吞没，严重阻碍后勤支援。 撤离时间延长40秒，“飞鹰”重新装弹时间延长30%，拾取获得的弹药数量减少50%。

1317.description_cn: 弹药箱与补给箱的补给数量减少 50%。

1318.name: GLOOM SOURCE
1318.description: This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30% and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.
1318.description_cn: 这颗星球持续积累厚重的“阴霾”孢子层，使后勤支援变得极其困难。 总增援数减少20%，“飞鹰”重新装弹时间延长30%，拾取获得的弹药数量减少50%。

1319.description_cn: 弹药箱与补给箱的补给数量减少 50%。

1331.name: WEAPONS EXPERIMENTATION
1331.description: The #V_ONE stratagem is available to all Helldivers.
1331.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1345.name: ORBITAL 120MM HE/EMS BARRAGE
1345.description: The Orbital 120mm HE Barrage is experimentally modified with additional HE rounds, EMS rounds, and a tighter radius.
1345.description_cn: 轨道120mm高爆弹火力网经实验性调整，增加了额外高爆弹与电磁电磁冲击弹，并缩小了效果范围半径。

1346.name: INCENDIARY GATLING BARRAGE
1346.description: The Orbital Gatling Barrage is experimentally modified to use incendiary rounds instead of HE rounds.
1346.description_cn: 轨道加特林火力网经实验性调整，改用燃烧弹替代高爆弹。

1350.name: SMOKE-ENHANCED WALKING BARRAGE
1350.description: The Orbital Walking Barrage is experimentally modified to have smoke rounds mixed into its salvos.
1350.description_cn: 轨道游走火力网经实验性调整，在齐射弹中混入了烟幕弹。

1351.description: The #V_ONE stratagem is available to all Helldivers.
1351.description_cn: #V_ONE战略配备可供所有绝地潜兵使用。

1365.description: All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown.
1365.description_cn: 所有轨道武器战略配备都会延长冷却时间。

1366.name: LESS BATTLEFIELD AMMO
1366.description_cn: 战场拾取物中将减少#V_ONE%的弹药。

1367.description: Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by #V_ONE.
1367.description_cn: 每位绝地潜兵上阵时配给的治疗剂数量减少#V_ONE。
